summary.headline: Planetary Disposition and Illness
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging illness, relapse, death, recovery, and the outcome of any matter through planetary disposition, reception, conjunction, fortune, malignity, and impediment. The concluding example traces Mercury’s conjunction with Venus after leaving Aries, Venus’s conjunction with Jupiter, and Jupiter’s reception.
